No fisherman's birthday bash would be complete without this top-shelf seafood dish.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Seafood Paellas are made by [[Cooking]] a [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]], [[Hylian Rice]], [[Goat Butter]], [[Rock Salt]], and either a [[Mighty Porgy]] or an [[Armored Porgy]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]].{{Cite Magazine/NM|quote= {{Color NM|Brown|'''Recipe Data'''
1 Hearty Blueshell Snail, 1 Hylian Rice, 1 Goat Butter, 1 Rock Salt, 1 Mighty Porgy (or an Armored Porgy)}}|date= 2021 Winter|page= 17}} These [[Meal]]s are considered top-shelf and are common in the birthday celebrations of fishermen. When [[Link]] speaks to [[Kiana]] in [[Lurelin Village]], she will ask her son [[Kinov]] what she should make for dinner.{{Cite|What should I cook for tonight's dinner?|Kiana|BotW}} Kinov responds that she should make Seafood Paella, to which Kiana agrees.{{Cite|Make your {{Color BotW|Blue|seafood paella}}! It's so good and yummy and great!|Kinov|BotW}}
{{Cite|That settles it! I'll make some {{Color BotW|Blue|seafood paella}}.|Kiana|BotW}} However, since she is low on ingredients, she asks Link to retrieve and Hearty Blueshell Snail and Goat Butter for her.{{Cite|We seem to be a bit short on ingredients though. We'll need {{Color BotW|Red|goat butter}} and a {{Color BotW|Red|hearty blueshell snail}}. I'm so busy with housework that I don't have time to go shopping for ingredients. Oh, I know! Could you go an get me the ingredients we're missing?|Kiana|BotW}} When Link returns with the ingredients, Kiana will ask for them.{{Cite|Oh! You have the ingredients! Can I have them?|Kiana|BotW}} She tells Link she wll start Cooking and gives him a [[Purple Rupee]] as a reward.{{Cite|All right, I'll take those, then. Now to start cooking. Here's a little something...|Kiana|BotW}} Kiana also invites Link to eat with her family since he brought her the ingredients, giving him Seafood Paella as well.{{Cite|Since you found the missing ingredients, why don't you eat with us? It'll be done soon.|Kiana|BotW}} Because the required ingredients are of contradicting effects, no variations of Seafood Paella can be made. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} [[Link]] can make Seafood Paella by [[Cooking]] any type of [[Crab]], either kind of [[Porgy]], [[Goat Butter]], [[Hylian Rice]], and [[Rock Salt]] together. Two variations of Seafood Paellas can be made: * '''Mighty Seafood Paella''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Seafood Paella}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
No fisherman's birthday bash would be complete without this top-shelf seafood dish.|Inventory|TotK}} These can be made by using [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]] and [[Razorclaw Crab]]s. When eaten, these Paellas boost [[Link]]'s strength. * '''Tough Seafood Paella''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Seafood Paella}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
No fisherman's birthday bash would be complete without this top-shelf seafood dish.|Inventory|TotK}} These can be made by using [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]] and [[Ironshell Crab]]s. When eaten, these Paellas boost [[Link]]'s toughness against attacks. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The recipe for Seafood Paella is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Bounty of the Sea]]". It is made using three [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s, three [[Tabantha Wheat]], three [[Fresh Milk]]s, three [[Fresh Milk]]s and three [[Goat Butter]]s. However, it can be lowered to two of each ingredient through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]]s will start the battle with three extra [[Heart]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Seafood Paella Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Seafood Paella ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
